messages.author: Liisa Lämpö
messages.text: Hi Antti, TRN-042 has a fan alarm that comes and goes. I saw the same alarm on another unit last month, can't remember which one that was.

messages.author: Antti Anturi
messages.text: Never mind the other one, nobody has asked about it. Is the alarm on a particular tray?

messages.author: Liisa Lämpö
messages.text: Just the one tray, the lower one. Sounds normal to me, though.

messages.author: Antti Anturi
messages.text: Then I'd take it out, blow out the dust and reseat it. It's usually dust on the connector rather than a dead fan.

messages.author: Liisa Lämpö
messages.text: So that's for TRN-042, not the other unit?

messages.author: Antti Anturi
messages.text: Yes, all of that is for TRN-042. I haven't looked at anything else.
